subject: general
question: On which of the following days is the World Asthma Day organised annually by the World Health Organization's collaborative organization - Global Initiative for Asthma?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 May.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **On 5 May, is the World Asthma Day organised annually by the World Health Organization's collaborative organization - Global Initiative for Asthma.**

 
• World Asthma Day is observed annually on the first Tuesday of May.
 
• The theme of 2020: Enough Asthma Deaths.
 
• This year it was celebrated on 05th May.
 
• It was organized by the Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA).
 
• Its purpose of it was to improve asthma awareness and care around the world.
 
• The first World Asthma Day was held in 1998 in more than 35 countries.
 
• The first world Asthma meeting was held in Barcelona, Spain.
